subject.title: fix(agents): guard restart-recovery timing heuristic to stale-gen runs only

question: Should maintainers preserve this PR's unique current-generation running-session regression test, or close this member-authored conflicting branch as fully superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95472?
rationale: Automation should not close a member-authored PR, and the remaining value is a maintainer choice about extra regression coverage rather than a correctness defect in the branch.

options.title: Cherry-pick the unique test
options.body: Apply only the running-session positive-path regression test on top of current main, then close this stale branch.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR because https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95472 already shipped the source fix and completed-session regression coverage.

options.title: Rebase this branch
options.body: Resolve conflicts only if maintainers intentionally want this member branch to become the canonical landing path.

recommendation.title: Cherry-pick the unique test
recommendation.body: Apply only the running-session positive-path regression test on top of current main, then close this stale branch.

likelyOwner.reason: openperf authored this member PR and has adjacent gateway/restart history, making them the best available owner for deciding whether the extra test should be preserved.
